body.condition: Under \(P^{\mathrm F}\), for every \(x\in\mathcal X\), the function \(a\mapsto m_x^{\mathrm F}(a)\) is continuous on \([0,\bar\delta]\).

novel.justification: This author-imposed scientific mean-regularity premise is weaker than conditional \(L^1\)-continuity of the full response path: it constrains only the fiberwise structural mean and only on the declared threshold range.  It is not attributed to Díaz et al.
